map.note: Census tracts touching the area · higher = more burdened

method: CalEnviroScreen 5.0 (draft) tract percentiles, weighted by population. Disadvantaged communities are DWR 2023 income-based block groups (median household income below 80% of the statewide figure). Income is ACS 2020–2024. Every tract or block group is apportioned by the share of its area inside the reachable area, assuming people are spread evenly within it.
